Long metal instruments cross the lower left. Below the mass lies an open wound field containing a pale pink tubular loop with yellow-orange rounded lobules on its surface and folded red surgical towels or drapes at the right. visual.general_description: Color microscopy image of a pink-purple stained tissue section with a large dark-red clotted area at the lower left and branching pale villous-like structures toward the upper right.
visual.detailed_description: A low-power field shows a large, intensely red region occupying the left and lower left with layered, fibrillar bands consistent in appearance with blood clot. Toward the upper center and right, many rounded and elongated pale spaces with thin pink-purple outlines and some dense purple clusters are arranged in a branching pattern against a white background; a few are cut off at the upper right where the field is blank. A thin dark-red streak and small red patches lie between the pale spaces and the red region. No printed text, panel letters, scale bar, arrows or labels are visible.
